beats.line: How about being stuck in a space where the map actively spawns hungry enemies
If you lived in London, England during the medieval period
you would've definitely heard about the Rat Dungeon. And this punishment struck
a paralyzing fear into the hearts of even the most hardened criminals
This was a cell located at the bottom of the Tower of London
where prisoners were shackled and chained in complete darkness. But here's the twist
the dungeon was connected to the nearby river
and built just below the river's high water line
so when the tide rose, all the rats that lived on the riverbed were pushed out of their shelters
and forced to swim downstream. This left the hungry
